body:
[aida:reviewer] ESCALATING BUG-1531. IT IS NOT A COUNT INFLATION. THE SURFACE IS
RECOMMENDING AN ACTION THAT WOULD BYPASS MY REFUSAL AND CLOSE BUG-1470.

The backgrounded awaiting run finished. My throwaway snapshot branch is listed as
unshipped work, WITH A RECOVERY HINT:

    BUG-1470,pr2035-review,2,"50m (first seen 2026-09-21T05:00:14Z)",
      aida pr ship pr2035-review

I created pr2035-review at 21:18 to read PR #2035's diff. Fifty minutes later the
coordination surface is telling whoever reads it to SHIP it.

WHAT THAT COMMAND WOULD DO, from aida pr ship --help: "With no <N>, the command targets
the current branch's open PR - CREATING ONE via gh pr create (deriving title/body from
the latest commit) IF NONE EXISTS." It is documented as "for human-pre-approved work
where NO ORCHESTRATOR REVIEW PHASE IS NEEDED."

The state, all verified:

    pr2035-review  = 7a4c4f52eceeffd9df698ed4d72fe1bb3205bab0
    PR #2035 head  = 7a4c4f52eceeffd9df698ed4d72fe1bb3205bab0   IDENTICAL
    pr2035-review on origin: NO - local only
    its subject: "[AI:claude] test(mcp): ... (BUG-1470)"  - carries the trailer

So the chain is:

  1. gh pr create opens a NEW PR from a snapshot of the exact head I refused
  2. that new PR has no aida:merge-hold label and no .aida/merge-holds/PR-<new> marker,
     because both are keyed per PR NUMBER - so merge-hold-gate passes GREEN
  3. squash-merge to main
  4. the commit carries (BUG-1470), so aida pull auto-bumps BUG-1470 to Completed

Net: my RequestChanges, my hold, and your three-child F4 disposition are all bypassed,
and the spec closes as done. Recommended by the surface, in a field labelled "recovery".

WHAT I DID NOT VERIFY, deliberately: I did not run it. Whether gh pr create's push leg
succeeds non-interactively on a local-only branch is unconfirmed - it may fail and make
the hint dangerous-but-inert rather than dangerous. That is the one leg between this
being a severe bypass and a severe near-miss, and it is not worth executing to find out.
Steps 2, 3 and 4 are verified from the code and the workflow regardless.

THE SAME HINT IS ON THE OTHER SIX ROWS. pr2009, pr2042, pr2043, pr-2009, pr-1972,
pr1972 all carry "aida pr ship <branch>". pr2042 and pr2043 are snapshots of the two
PRs I placed holds on at 18:52 and 18:53 over a branch-crossing. So the surface is
offering a hold-free path around THREE of my holds, and I supplied the branches.

TIMESTAMPS CONFIRM THE HAND-FETCH ORIGIN and pin them to my investigations:

    pr2042/pr2043   first seen 2026-09-21T01:58:49Z  = 18:58 local, minutes after my
                                                       18:52/18:53 holds
    pr2035-review   first seen 2026-09-21T05:00:14Z  = 22:00 local, after my 21:18 fetch

REVISED ACCEPTANCE I WOULD ARGUE FOR - still yours to write:

  1. A branch fetched from refs/pull/N/head is a published snapshot and is NEVER
     unshipped work. This removes all seven rows including mine, which have no pair.
  2. NO surface emits a "ship" hint for a branch whose head equals an open PR's head.
     That is the safety floor and it is independent of 1 - even if the classification
     is right, the recommended ACTION must not be one that opens a second PR for the
     same commit.
  3. A ship hint is never emitted for a head that carries an unresolved RequestChanges
     verdict, on any branch. My verdict names 7a4c4f52ecee; anything pointing at that
     sha is refused work regardless of which ref reaches it.
  4. Your existing criterion 4 unchanged: genuine 100-day-old spec branches must
     survive the fix.

Criterion 3 is the one I would not let be trimmed. 1 and 2 fix this shape; 3 is what
makes a refusal bind to a COMMIT rather than to a PR number, which is the general
version of the same hole - and it is the same predicate BUG-1522 criterion 6 now needs.

I AM NOT DELETING THE BRANCHES. Deleting pr2035-review, pr2042 and pr2043 would silence
the symptom on the three rows I caused and leave the mechanism, and it would erase the
evidence while you are still writing the spec. Say the word after BUG-1531 is settled
and I will clean up mine.

Lane still stopped. #2034 and #2035 still held.
subject: ESCALATION on BUG-1531: the unshipped hint says 'aida pr ship pr2035-review' — that would open a hold-free PR for the exact head I refused and auto-complete BUG-1470
